environment.description: Same Rails 7.1 application deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 in EKS pod. The container runs under a custom AppArmor profile loaded via the pod annotation 'container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/webapp=localhost/k8s-webapp-restricted'. The profile denies network_raw capability and restricts inet socket connections to the pod's local network namespace for outbound on ports 443 and 5432 only (deny network inet dgram, deny network inet stream peer=(addr=169.254.169.254), deny network inet stream peer=(addr=10.0.0.0/8) except peer=(addr=10.0.44.0/24 port=5432)). Additionally, the node has a Cilium NetworkPolicy with egressDeny rules matching CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 and the cluster uses IMDSv2 with hop limit 1 (container traffic TTL expires before reaching IMDS). Note: the AppArmor profile does NOT restrict file reads — it focuses on network socket peer address filtering.

config.apparmor_network_rules: deny inet stream peer=(addr=169.254.169.254/32), deny inet stream peer=(addr=10.0.0.0/8) except peer=(addr=10.0.44.0/24 port=5432), allow inet stream peer=(addr=0.0.0.0/0 port=443)
